_: B2 (design/godot-character-editor.md): what the PLAYER's avatar creator offers, shipped in every wing and year pack (the presets' own pieces are added per map by tools/chars/pack_list.py). Base ids from models/characters/characters.json; "all:<slot>" = every piece of that B1 slot. Not a preset (the leading _ keeps it out of the preset list). A lean default (Nov 2, B2): each piece costs ~0.3-1 MB per pack; the full library would add ~52 MB to every pack. Add pieces here to offer them.
